   IF result.omissions contains "No authorized active repository link is mapped" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-code-index`. Say: "The workspace has no active, agent-visible repository link, so no code was searched (lpm-code-index)."
   SAVE: hits = result.results, or empty when result.omissions contains "semantic neighbours only"
2. IF <saved:hits> is not empty → go to step 5.
3. IF <input:query2> == "none" → SAVE: facts = "none"; inferences = "none"; go to Answer.
4. CALL `search_workspace_code` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","query":"<input:query2>","limit":8} [A]
   SAVE: hits = result.results, or empty when result.omissions contains "semantic neighbours only"
   IF <saved:hits> is empty → SAVE: facts = "none"; inferences = "none"; go to Answer.
5. SAVE: reads = the first 3 items of <saved:hits> with documentKind "code" and endLine ≤ 200

6. FOR EACH hit IN <saved:reads> (none → go to step 7):

7. SAVE: facts = one line per item of <saved:hits> with documentKind "code": "F<n> <what lines <startLine>-<endLine> do, read in the excerpt or the hit text> — <path>:<startLine>-<endLine>@<first 7 characters of commitSha> (code, workspace-wide)", or "none" when no item has documentKind "code"
   SAVE: inferences = one line per other item: "I<n> <path> mentions <input:query> — certainty low — from a <documentKind> hit, not implementation", or "none"
